text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl has suffered an injury, so I've brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! This is nothing to cause a fuss over.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Just take a look! See?! Hup! Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Phew… I'm as nimble as always, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So many possibilities are still waiting to be explored, so let's get back to training!
choice_data_list: You should take a break to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sigh… All right. So that's your final decision…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …Fine. That dance just now was the best I could muster. If it wasn't enough to convince you…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Then I guess I have no choice but to take it easy until I'm fully recovered.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, you won't regret this! Let's go and explore my possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It seems I pushed my limits too far and danced a little too hard…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl's injury appears to have taken a heavy toll on her, forcing her to take a break and focus on recovering.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wheeew! That was no problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! As long as you don't lose heart, nothing in the world is impossible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl demonstrates her possibilities magnificently by quickly making a smooth comeback.
